description: Across the scenario library at 1080p, 1440p and 4K: frame time p50 and p99, load time, address space, commit and VRAM, for system d3d9 (proxy pass-through) against the pinned DXVK. Settle DXVK's display mode (fact napoleon.dxvk.menu_display_mode) and its dxvk.conf defaults as config_keys. Output: a committed baseline file every later phase 3 job reports against, and proposed per-feature frame-time and memory budgets for Liam to agree.
title: Performance baseline: system d3d9 against DXVK
